nom: Bubble Solar Mate Daily Mineral SPF 40

avis.texte: I like that this sunscreen has very little white cast on my fair skin, and I don't mind the smell that everyone has been commenting on, but the texture of it on my face is very sticky. By the end of the day I feel like every particle of dust and dirt has stuck to my face because the finish never dried down.

avis.titre: I will use this mineral sunscreen again
avis.texte: Getting ready to cut grass and work in the yard I used my Bubble Solar Matte SPF40 Zinc oxide sunscreen. It is light weight with little or no white cast left on face. It is easy to pump tube after I primed it. It is unscented , water resistant (needed in 100 degree heat). It is not greasy and did not irritate my face while working in the sun

I got this as a sample and lemme just say that I don't enjoy writing negative reviews but this one was necessary. I actually strongly dislike this. The smell is awful and lasts throughout the day. The product makes a blue/white cast over the face. Any glow you have will be turned to white cast, matte and faded. It pills up on the skin and if you don't rub it in all the way, even slightly, you will have a white streak across your face. Under makeup, it makes everything look dry and crusty. I would never spend money on this. Thank u, next.
One star off bec smell funny tho I love it anyways keep protecting my skin from the sun
I really love this sunscreen and wear it every single day, no matter what. I have sensitive skin and rosacea and I really recommend this product.

its smells soooo bad like a wet dog if you know how that smells but also like bananas. Ewe. im not like the product is great but I literally have to plug my nose to put it on. LITERALLY. but it's a no show sunscreen so that's a win but like I siad the smell.
smells like hotdog water, washes out your skintone and doesnt even have good protection against the sun. Plus, it has a weird texture to it when it dries that leaves your face feeling sticky
Since I'm on prescription tret. and azaelic acid, I needed a mineral sunscreen that would not leave a white cast. I also have an allergy to niacinamide and I am so happy that I found this!

I have very acne-prone sensitive skin with type 1/2 rosacea. I also have perioral dermatitis, mostly around my lips. This is the absolute best sunscreen! The smell is definitely not the most pleasant, but it goes away when it's dried into your skin. I've tried ALL the sunscreens, ranging from the cheapest to the most expensive, including aesthetician recommendations. This is the only one I will use!

avis.titre: Waste of money, doesn't protect against sun
avis.texte: I could get past the smell if this actually worked. It kinda smells like feet until it dries. I put on a thick layer and was in the sun for about an hour and burned pretty badly! This did nothing considering it's supposedly spf 40! Waste of money.

avis.titre: No white cast on Bengali skintone
avis.texte: I have extremely oily/sensitive/prone to pimples skin/hormone issues. I can basically put almost nothing on my face or I'll break out. There's only one sunscreen I use but the white cast is slightly noticeable (DrJart Mineral sunscreen for oily skin people only) I was looking for another mineral sunscreen without white cast or heavy tint (will break out) and tried a few. This one has no white cast. And the formula doesn't make my skin oily (dewy) which would also break me out. I did get oilier skin throughout the day on a relatively cool day like today so not sure if I'll break out when it's hotter out. This smells like old school mineral sunscreen. The smell is fine for me. I'll be keeping this even if I break out on hot days because I can wear it on the cooler days (under 65) with a high UV index (over 3). I highly recommend this! Note for the photos, my face tone is naturally lighter than my neck like most people.
It blends in easy and doesn't leave me with a white cast (I have pale skin). Although I can't get past the awful smell and the lingering sticky feeling.

avis.titre: Black girls— THIS is for us!!
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin that reacts to chemical sunscreens almost immediately. This is the first mineral sunscreen that actually doesn't leave a white cast. I don't have to rub for 20 minutes or wait for the white cast to "fade". My sensitive skin also doesn't react to it.
Super lightweight and great for sensitive skin! It has definitely become a must in my everyday routine! Definitely recommend!
I like how it looks on my skin but I couldn't get pass the stickiness..

avis.titre: Genuinely good sunscreen but the smell is awful
avis.texte: Ok I like this sunscreen a lot. It's not greasy at all, it doesn't pill under my makeup, no white cast, and the pump makes application easy. I have very dry skin and it doesn't break me out. However, the smell is genuinely awful. When you put it on, it goes away after a few seconds. But those few seconds are mouth-breathing seconds. Is it so awful I won't use the whole thing? No. Is it so awful I may not repurchase? Unsure.
I wanted to love this as I love many products from this brand; not this one. Incredibly sticky! I will use it up so it wont go to waste, but i wont be repurchasing.

So I have combination skin that's acne prone and this hasn't broke me out and doesn't feel heavy. It's lightweight. Now there is a smell, but it's not as awful as the reviews say it just smells like sunscreen not the coconut ones though.

Ive used this for about four days now and i really like how it goes on. It blends easy and it has very minimal white cast. I can see what people are saying about the smell, and i think the ginseng extract is to blame. It does go away, for me its never lingered. I like that its not only broad spectrum, but also combats blue rat damage too. I like the pump mechanism, unsure how effective itll be once i start running low but we shall see.
I would have given this 5 stars if not for the bad smell because other than that, it's great. but won't repurchase

At first I HATED this product, I tried it right after I had bought it and it felt freakin terrible on the skin by itself. I decided to give it another chance & paired it with A VERY moisturizing moisturizer and I actually ended up liking the product. DOES NOT PEEL!!! DOES NOT BURN EYES! Note that this has a slight white cast. Not sure what smell people are talking about? This smells like nothing.
so I tried it on and it's a decent sunscreen but the smell is HORRIBLE it smells like moldy bread

I wanted to love this SPF so much as its mineral with clean ingredients. Bought for myself and my daughter. I could not figure out why I kept getting a tan/brown nose when using for a daily SPF layer under makeup. Its the product!!!! It literally does nothing for SPF protection. I mean, I would get a tan/brown nose just being outside on yard duty and I do not burn easily. Finally after using it snowboarding yesterday on a partly cloudy, overcast day and STILL getting a brow nose (after not having used this product since last summer) I'm convinced its the product. No way there is SPF in it, especially SPF 40!!!! My Olay SPF 15 will protect me all day for normal daily use. Do NOT recommend at all.

the comments dont lie it has such a strong smell I cant get past it and im not someone with a super senstive nose. I will be attempting to return once I'm not snowed in. I love their other products so far but this smells AWFUL
This is my favorite sunscreen ever!! It's so good and lasts a pretty long time. Mine lasted around 7 months

Honestly kind of shocked by the bad reviews here. I have really sensitive combination skin and this is the best sunscreen I've tried, especially for the price. It doesn't make my skin greasy, absorbs quickly, and it's a thinner formula that doesn't feel heavy on the face. Sunscreens almost always make me break out but I've never had that problem with this one. The smell isn't great but it doesnt bother me.

avis.titre: Not terrible, but not the best
avis.texte: Bought it because Ulta didnt have my goto sunscreen by Good Molecule. As soon as you pump product out, it hits you like a bag of bricks. It is very strong and smelly. Do t breathe while appplying. It goes on nicely but I do have a greasy feel left on my face after my daily skincare routine. Overall the price isnt terrible, but you arent getting world class product either.

I ended up returning this. I prefer mineral sunscreens for pregnancy, and I have been on the hunt for the best. Pros: Very minimal white cast; pump is great; good with my sensitive skin. Cons: Heavy, thick, and sticky; smell (goes away fast).

avis.titre: Amazing sunscreen for sensitive, acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I've been hunting for a sunscreen that doesn't irritate my skin, and this mineral sunscreen from Bubble is the winner. I've tried multiple sunscreens within the last two years, from well-known to new brands, and I found that Bubble Solar Mate is the only sunscreen that seems to work for my skin. The other mineral sunscreens I've tried from other brands irritate my skin because of certain ingredients that my skin dislikes. The other sunscreens claimed to be non-irritating, but I always felt misled in the end. I've come here to express my gratitude for the Solar Mate mineral sunscreen because it is the only one that agrees with my skin. Pros: Non-irritating Acne friendly Mineral based No horrible white cast Not greasy, but rather moisturizing Applies well to skin Cons: The scent may throw some people off, but it doesn't for me.
The sunscreen itself is good and I will continue to use it, however this product smells SO BAD. Like I cant even fathom how its possible, but it makes me gag every time i pump product out

I could not get past the smell of this sunscreen. It went on smoothly, zero white cast. It doesnt feel heavy or greasy. But catching whiffs of it all day long made me gag. I could not wait to get home and wash my face. I went on a daytrip and forgot my usual mineral sunblock. I do have sensitive skin. Ulta was out of my brand so I purchased the Bubble Solar Mate Mineral sunscreen. The smell was overwhelming. I thought it would go away. It did not dissipate, and all day I could smell it. Also, whenever I was in direct sunlight my skin would tingle & feel slightly burnt. I have only had this tingling reaction to one other mineral sunscreen, it was Cerave.

10/10 recommend! Worked wonders for me! I would say my skin is more on the sensitive side and this product has not broke me out. Does have a little more of a stronger sunscreen smell, but it doesn't really bother me.. it also leaves a nice glow to the skin!

I've been using this sunscreen for about 3 weeks now and my skin has been loving it! No negative side effects AND it wears really well under makeup. It does have a slight white cast, but that was to be expected as it is a mineral sunscreen and mineral sunscreens are meant to sit on the face. I will say it does have a pretty strong unpleasant smell at first, it smells like the backing of an earring iykyk, but that smell quickly goes away after you've rubbed the product in. I've not once got a whiff of that smell throughout the day. It's really not that big of a deal for me. I will keep repurchasing this item!

avis.titre: LEAVES WHITE CAST ON DARKER SKIN!!
avis.texte: I would buy again, but the consistency is kind of sticky which is weird, and it's not really spreadable. And the main reason I bought this, because it didn't leave a white cast, it completely false! I'm black with a dark skin color and it said it suits all skin colors and doesn't leave a white cast. BEWARE IT DOES!
This gave me red bumps on my face and neck and dried out my skin. It's also thick and smells weird.
Got this and i love it. Does not leave no white cast or no burning to my eyes. I have oily combo skin and this leaves my face not feeling oily one bit. Will be repurchasing again!!!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love the smooth and full coverage I get from this product. The smell of it isn't my favorite, however it's not a deal breaker for me .I love that the product is not greasy or sticky.the product is light weight and that is super important to me as well.

I had high hopes but this product was very disappointing i wish i could return it. It does smell nasty when you first apply but after the smell goes away. This product is not moisturizing at all, instead it makes my face feel really dry but the sensation it leaves heavy and greasy. It also leaves a big white cast that takes a while to go away. Overall don't recommend you buy it.

this worked great. I used it one day when i went to the lake. Never stoped using it since! I only need to apply every 2-3 hours and didnt give me a sunbrun. It was never oily or gave a whitecast. 10/10 Would recommend!

This is a good sunscreen because it absorbs quickly, doesn't run and sting my eyes, and its easy to carry around. There is a definte white cast though when I apply it over my makeup and it smells like hangover throw up. It's so bad I would hold my breath to apply it.
I prefer a thinner SPF sunscreen for my face. This product is a little too thick for me because it leaves a bit of a white cast and tugs my face a little more than some other products i have tried.

This product is solidly 3 stars. It does dry down pretty nicely and doesnt peel, which is a huge plus. But I literally made multiple people smell it right out of the tube because I thought it had gone off. It smells like sewage. The smell goes away after a few minutes, but if you are smell sensitive at all I'd steer clear of this. Disappointed because I usually love this brand.

Love the branding and packaging! Do like that it is a pump use. However, it does have a smell from when you first pump it out but once it is applied the smell is gone. Other than the initial scent it gives off coming from the bottle it works just fine. Due to the odor I won't buy it again.

So far, this has been a great addition to my skincare. No pilling, no white casting, blends well, not oily or heavy, absorbs fully, and protects from day-to-day sun exposure. I still use a powder foundation over top, but I've been pleased with the effects and lightweight feel of this spf product!

I was really looking forward to this cause it had good reviews and I usually use cerave so I was finding something that maybe a lot better because my cerave sunscreen sometimes had a tendency to peel. I don't know if I got a hold of a bad tube, but the smell was absolutely horrible with this and even after it dried it felt a little tacky to the skin so I will not re-order. Made my skin feel dry as well. I like a more moisturizing sun screen.

avis.titre: Not as bad as the reviews say
avis.texte: Thw reviews say ghat this is a smelly product. But the smell isn't that bad. It feels weightless on the skin. It also looks good under makeup

I started using this about a year ago after learning that sunscreen is the most important part of a morning skin care routine. I LOOOOVE this one! FOR ME PERSONALLY, this doesn't leave any white cast at all, it's not oily or greasy, which is important to me as someone with oily skin, and it dries down to an almost primer-like feel on the skin. My grandmother is in her 80's and she looks like she's in her 60's due to the Zinc SPF protection in her foundation she uses, and that's why I chose this sunscreen with zinc! I want to look like her at that age! The smell doesn't bother me. I see some other reviews talking about how rank it is, but to me, it's really not that bad at all. It's a little chalky smelling, but I feel like all sunscreen has a smell, even if they're not the heavily fragranced ones. I'm about to buy my second tube!
No way they made this, smelled it, and said yes perfect put it on the shelf. Its not even a chemical smell but just rancid. Its also tacky- not weightless.

Bought this wanting a good "clean" sunscreen. It smeels like soured clothes or stinky feer when you first put it on. The smell went away for a little while and came back during the day as i had it inder my make up. Will not repurchase or recommend
This sunscreen is perfect for oily skin, has little to no smell and there is no white cast at all. Will definitely buy over and over!!

avis.titre: Good sunscreen but smell is god awful
avis.texte: What the title says. The sunscreen itself is nice, I like that it uses a pump instead of a squeeze bottle. It goes on nice and doesn't have a white cast from what I can tell. It does feel a little sticky after being in the sun or sweating. The smell is horrific honestly. I've never written a review for a product before but I felt compelled to do so because it is that bad. I'll keep using it until the smell gets to be too much. I would not repurchase due to that alone.
I purchased this elsewhere without doing any research beforehand, and it was such a waste of money I had to throw it away. It smells so bad, the texture is greasy and it broke me out terribly.

Literally my favorite mineral SPF ever. I've tested out a few but this is hands down my FAV. Liah Yoo (youtuber) recommended this and I have no regrets! Yes, it does have a smell but it's not that bad, trust me haha
Im very picky with my sunscreens but i loved this doesnt feel really like a sunscreen at all theres no artificial scents but the scent it has is very stinky
This sunscreen is super nice, and applies easily, but there is one problem. When you first take it out of the packaging, it smells like someone threw up, but it is good after a while.
This sunscreen is super nice, and applies easily, but there is one problem. When you first take it out of the packaging, it smells like someone threw up, but it is good after a while.

Great mineral sunscreen and spf. Doesn't break me out and makes my skin feel moisturized. The smell is a little weird though, and the bottle is not my favorite, but overall would purchase again because it works really well for me!

Guys I was reading a lot on the reviews and they said that it smelled horrible, and I have it and it does small kinda bad, but its not about the smell its about what works best for you!✨🫶🏽 BY BESTIES✨🫶🏽💖

avis.titre: I will stick with CETAPHIL PRO OIL ABSORBING MOISTURIZER spf
avis.texte: It says no white case such a lie especially on darker skin tone in dont like the feel of it at all.cetaphil is more lighter sheer and moisturizing. The smell is extremely off puting. It's a no for me will be returning

avis.titre: It smells like stinky socks. I had to return
avis.texte: I couldn't get past the smell of stinky socks. Had to return. Dont know if it was a bad batch.

I have medium deep skin tone and this does leave a little bit of white cast on me. It is really moisturizing and does not cause stinging. Since the cast is not noticeable i will definitely purchase again

I chose this because it has no comedogenic ingredients and it's got pros and cons. I can get past all the cons: hate the bottle and smells and looks terrible. BUT affordable, lightweight and absorbs so well into my skin.

This is hands down the BEST mineral sunscreen! At first I thought it'd leave a telltale white cast as it was clearly visible upon application, but after massaging in, it completely disappeared! Im super impressed, it's literally the first mineral option that actually delivers. This is my second Bubble purchase, the first being the StarDew eye cream and I love them both. Def recommend!
This product is so good. I've used it every day since I got it. This sunscreen doesn't leave white marks at all. Im definitely going to be repurchasing this again. ❤️

My holy grail SPF. I would rec this to everyone. There's barely any white cast and is mineral! I decided to buy this because I saw Liah Yoo recommend it and I have no regrets! I'm so glad I found this!!!

avis.titre: Not my favorite, perhaps I received a bad batch
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this spf, the ingredients seemed great and there are no pore cloggers in it. But unfortunately it separated so badly on my skin. It was like the spf filters separated from the rest of the formula, so there were little white streaks all over my face that took a while to blend in and ended up pilling on me and leaving a bit of a greasy residue. I'm not sure if I received a bad batch or something? As far as the smell, it's really not that bad. Its a fragrance-free product so the sour smell is just what the ingredients smell like. FWIW I have noticed that all zinc-based spfs have that smell.

avis.titre: not the best far from the worst.
avis.texte: i really like how the texture of this formula is smooth, doesnt leave a greasy or thick residue on my skin. lightweight, easy to apply, and i always love a 40 spf. however. the stench. i hold my breath when applying this on my skin every morning to try and avoid accidentally catching a whiff. somewhere between stinky socks and the musty scent in the back of a minivan thats driven too many kids home from soccer practice- its quite suspect. if you're like me and have a sensitive sniffer- i'd say stay away! i wouldn't recommend this product to a friend- but maybe someone i got in an argument with a couple months ago that was never resovled.

I usually wear the innis free no white cast one but decided to try this out since its similar orice point. This product is really greesy. You have to rub it in for quite some time and its really thick. It probably works just fine to protect my skin though.
Love the formula but it literally smells like dirty feet. The smell is so spot on that I'm assuming they wanted it to smell that way. Such a shame because I thibk the formula is great.

I have mature skin and this is bery matte and will not crease under my makeup. Love that it has zinc and mineral formula. Not scented. I live it on my chest and arms as well for daily use. I do have an oily t sone area. Ive used very expensive formulas that do not compare! This was my daughters and i used it one day and fell in love! I actually love most of their products!

I love this sunscreen. it goes on smooth, doesnt leave a white cast, and feels good on my skin. I love thats its mineral based and is spf 40. idk why theres so many comments that say it smells bad? I dont notice any smell

avis.titre: Good product, but it smells awful.
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen and will be buying again, the only downside is it smells like sunscreen and sweaty feet. You don't smell it very much once it's applied, but if you're sensitive to smells I would avoid this.

avis.titre: This product is perfectly matte but it broke me out
avis.texte: I love the texture and mattification of this sunscreen but i broke out in two inflammed breakouts after using it for two days. I do love the tinted sunscreen though!
It smells very bad, it works nice but you need to change the smell
this was my least favorite bubble product. it hardly lasts 45 minutes and the smell is AWFUL. Would not recommend.

It is a good sunblock and I really like this brand but it is not the greatest. I thought it was fine but it took forever to rub in and still left greasy splotches sometimes. I know some people like more oily but this sunscreen was also insanely oily.

This smells so bad! It smells like actual fecal matter on your face. That is really not the desired experience. I'm very pale and I get no white cast, but then I don't usually notice one. I often get burning eyes from cheap face SPF, but this didn't burn my eyes. I tried it out as soon as I got it but I was so focused on watching for an eye reaction that I didn't even notice the smell till I'd already thrown out the box, and now I'm mad about it.

It works well, no white cast, works good no sunburn but it does not smell very good when you first put it on but after a minute the smell goes away. I would but this again but just be warned about the smell.

As a healthcare worker I've smelled similiar scents at work and the last thing I want is a reminder of my job slathered on my face. Its a heavy, musty, crayon like smell that permeates your whole senses when you put it slightly up to your face. Smells like soaked dirty laundry and it is STRONG. So unfortunate because the packaging is so cute and the formula is plush and creamy! It just leaves me horrified whenever I try to use it!

avis.titre: Is this company owned by Crayola?
avis.texte: I dont understand why every single skin product ive tried of Bubble smells so strongly of crayons… I wanted to love this too because im so picky about sunscreen and the consistency is beautiful. The smell is such a turn off.

Smells bad , also daughters got fried using it , didnt notice until after that it said it's not water resistant if you are swimming or sweating . Seems like it's a necessity for a sunscreen to at least hold up to sweat. Would not recommend at all.
If you apply the correct amount there is a white cast so I can only imaging when you reapply. Don't let the marketing fool you.

Doesn't burn my eyes like chemical sunscreens do! It does have a very weird smell when first applied and leaves a slight white cast, but this disappears within a few minutes. Feels good when it's on. I did notice it's not great under makeup, though.

Ive tried so many sunscrens and most of them have broken me out or made me look really oily, but this one is perfection! Other than the wierd smell, which is not as bad as the reviews are saying. I think people are just used to stuff with fragrance. But I prefer fragrance free everything! Yes its weird but it goes away in minutes. May not be for everyone but it works wonders gor me!

Its good for kids skin. It takes 30 minutes before drying to go into the sun, so if you need to put a suncreen on then go outside, this is not the sunscreen for that. This is a daily sunscreen, so only use it if your going to work or school. Do not use this if you are going into the pool or going to be sweating. IT ALSO STINKS SOOO BADDD!
The feeling of this product is nasty and unsanitary it dries out your skin and feels so rough when u put it on i would not recommend it
The feeling of this product is nasty and unsanitary it dries out your skin and feels so rough when u put it on i would not recommend it

Rarely leave reviews, but this products smells ABSOLUTELY AWFUL. My boyfriend even made a comment about the smell left on my skin afterward. Only good thing about this is the packaging and thats its a mineral spf

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: Solar mate was definitely an amazing choice! I got some bubble skincare and I got this. I love it and am obsessed! It blends in and does not irritate my skin. Would definitely recommend this product.
I've tried so many sunscreens but this one is awesome !! It moisturizes and provides excellent protection. I finally found the best solution for sun protection
It seemed promising at first. I have brown skin, and I was able to rub in two pumps easily with no noticeable white cast. However, once I was out, it made my skin feel uncomfortably dry all day.

avis.titre: Good spf but smells so weird
avis.texte: I used it for few days, doesn't give me any bad reaction since I have acne prone skin but it has very weird smell to it so I have to make a return
It helped with my face not getting sunburnt, but has a unpleasant smell.

avis.titre: The best spf, on my second bottle.
avis.texte: Yes it does have a weird smell to it but once applied and absorbed you can not smell it at all. This is the only spf that has not aggravated my perioral dermatitis. Other spfs would cause redness, burning, and peeling, but not this one! Im fairly light and i do notice the white cast others mention but it blends in well in less than a minute. Highly recommend for sensitive skin!
Was hoping to love this product. The consistancy is nice, I like how it spreads on my skin. Does leave a bit of a white cast but it smells really bad, like smelly feet. I cannot tolerate the smell.

I really love this product! Its perfect except for one thing, which is why it gets 4/5 stars. Pros: - Non-comedogenic, safe for acne prome skin!! (My skin is super sensy) - great under water based makeup (no pilling) - great SPF, does its job - even application - would and will continue to use/buy Cons: - it smells super funky

avis.titre: sticky texture with no dry down
avis.texte: I tried this out when I couldn't find the K-beauty sunscreen I usually use. This just was not for me, it has a really sticky texture and takes a really long time to dry down if it dries down at all. I think it made me break out, it's also not sweat proof or waterproof. If you're looking for something that dries down matte, this is definitely not it.
this would be my favorite sunscreen but my goodness it smells so bad!

avis.titre: Smells Bad, Thick and not the smoothest to spread
avis.texte: I bought this because I was looking for an affordable mineral sunscreen. The smell is horrendous. It goes away after a while, but I can't stand applying it. It also is very thick and does not spread as easily as other sunscreens. You need to work fast with this sunscreen. It doesn't have a white cast, but I still would not recommend it.

This product really exceeded my expectations - lightweight, blended well with no white cast, held up under makeup and especially no sunscreen smell! Tried it all summer and will definitely get it again.

It does what it's supposed to which is sun protection. I however had to get rid of mine because after months wearing it it wouldn't evenly moisturize my skin but my greatest reason to discontinued use is the smell that it has when you first apply. I couldn't live with it anymore so on to another product I go.
This sunscreen smells really gross. It works super well, but it just smells so bad. After you rub it in, the smell wears off but do you really want to deal with smelling it every time you put it on?
Does the job but smells disgusting! I never return products but truly could not stand this one.

Definitely recommend if you have sensitive + oily skin. I struggle trying to find a good sunscreen that works with my oily skin. This sunscreen leaves my skin mate throughout the day which I love. The smell is a little disgusting though but it only smell when you first put it on.

I wnated to love this sunscreen. The first time i used it, i noticed a weird smell. To me it smelled like throw up. I rubbed it in between my hands and put it on my face, because i still wnated to try it out. I like how it felt on my face, i have sensitive skin. And the smell went away and just smelled like sunscreen. I wanted to keep it but i couldnt get past the smell before i applied it. i had to return it.
So I started using this a couple months ago and the texture of it is absolutely unreal it feels like literal velvet. the applicator is cute, but it kinda dried out over time
I was so excited to try this product since my friend had it. I tried so hard to love it. It leaves such a white cast and takes me up to two minutes to blend absolutely not

avis.titre: Holy Grail Sunscreen for Brown Skin!!!
avis.texte: I have sensitive/rosacea/acne prone brown skin and have had a hard time finding an affordable mineral sunscreen that doesn't leave a noticeable white cast or cause irritation. This sunscreen goes on white, but becomes nearly invisible after rubbing it in for a few seconds and I have NO irritation! 10/10 recommend!!
Love that this does not leave any white cast and blends well with other serums I use. Def a go to:)
I would totally recommend this product! It works so good and I just loved it!

that smell. there is something about it that it so of putting and strong it lingers. the texture is great but it also doesnt layer well with makeup. i dont have this problem with other subscreens but it feels like it just leaves a layer for my makeup to sit on and rub off. really tried to like it.
